interface_findings.default_highlight: dropdown.js showDropdownMenu adds sudo-hover to DOM item one when domain != story, then logs open/reopen. It does not set currentHoverIndex or emit hover. An opening hover snapshot is therefore not evidence of default highlighting; currentSuggestionIndex initializes to zero regardless of domain.
interface_findings.display_order: logging.js getSuggestionState enumerates displayed DOM items in order. dropdown.js may sort by score before rendering and filters empty trimmed strings. config.js currently sets sortSuggestions=true. The retained log menu is the display order; current source does not establish historical sorting or randomized assignment.
interface_findings.domain_mapping: The released frontend/index.html fixes domain=story. Prepared corpus domains creative/argumentative do not authenticate historical frontend configuration; sampled raw schema contains no domain/key fields. Keep default-first for all menus and default-first only for argumentative menus as explicitly hypothetical sensitivity policies, never observed exposure. Current released code is source context, not proof all historical logs used it.
interface_findings.hover_event: dropdown.js mouseover stores the option identity in currentHoverIndex and logs suggestion-hover. logging.js declares that field valid only for suggestion-hover; other snapshots can be stale. Mouse click sets both indices to the option identity before selection. Hover identities are mapped through the displayed menu's index fields.
interface_findings.keyboard_navigation: index.js arrow keys move and wrap currentIndex over DOM positions, apply sudo-hover and emit suggestion-up/down without suggestion-hover. Those events use currentSuggestionIndex as displayed position, independently of original option identity. editor.js Enter clicks the highlighted item, whose click handler logs selection; keyboard versus mouse selection is not directly identified.
